meta.title: E02 · RF front end — does a preselect filter / LNA help, and does an LNA cost us?
meta.description: bladeRF · combined · crossing grid, Frontline RF on (jammers active). Each variant is the same payload with a different analog front end. This isolates the hardware: A bare SDR, B an LNA only, C a preselect filter only, D filter→LNA (the recommended build), E LNA→filter (wrong order).
